name: LanguageRow
title: LanguageRow
summary: A language entry in the dot.bible directory: native-script name first, English name second, format badges (Read, Listen, Print, App) and a ↗, as a list row or as a card.
whenToUse: Use `.sx-lang` rows inside `.sx-langlist` for the full directory of 500+ languages and search results.
Use `.sx-lcard` cards for a small set of featured or nearby languages.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for the hero of a single language page; use BibleCard.
Do not use as a language switcher for the site UI; use Select or Combobox.

anatomy.description: Each row is one link: name block, badges, ↗. Card:

props.name: variant
props.description: `row`: list row inside a `LanguageList`. `card`: card for featured languages.

props.name: nativeName
props.description: Language name written in its own script, shown first. Never show only the English name.

props.name: nativeLang
props.description: BCP 47 code of the native name (BCP 47), for example "am". Needed so fonts and screen readers pick the right voice.

props.name: nativeDir
props.description: Set "rtl" for Arabic-script and Hebrew names.

props.name: englishName
props.description: English name exactly as in the directory ("Burmese"). Card meta may replace it with `meta`.

props.name: meta
props.description: Card only: secondary line such as "Amharic · Ethiopia · 57M speakers (sample)". Defaults to `englishName`.

props.name: formats
props.description: Formats available for this language; show only those that exist.

props.name: divider
props.description: Draw the hairline above this row. `LanguageList` sets it for every row after the first.

variants.notes: 72px min, native name 22px, hairline between rows
name renders RTL inside an LTR row

variantNotes: Row states: default; hover (`.is-hover` in the preview): `--blue-tint` background, badges turn white, ↗ turns Horizon Blue; focus ring. Card states: hover lifts to `--shadow-lift` and ↗ turns Horizon Blue; focus ring. Under 768px rows wrap: badges drop under the name, ↗ spans both lines.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Native-script name first, in `--font-sans` 600; English name after it in 14px `--gray-600`. Never show only the English name.
Give scripts with tall marks more line-height (Burmese 1.6, Urdu 1.5); the CSS does this through `:lang(my)` and `:lang(ur)`.
Show only the formats that exist for that language, in the order Read, Listen, Print, App.
Badges are neutral `--gray-100` pills with a 14px icon; never colour-code formats.
The whole row is one link to the language page, so it ends with ↗. Do not nest other links or buttons inside.
Row and card minimum height respects the 44px tap target (rows are 72px).
Speaker counts are samples until confirmed; label them "(sample)".

accessibility: Always set `lang` on `.sx-native`, and `dir="rtl"` for Arabic-script and Hebrew names, so screen readers and fonts pick the right voice and shaping.
The ↗ is `aria-hidden`; the link's text (native + English name + formats) is its accessible name.
Badge icons are `aria-hidden="true"`; the word carries the meaning.
Keep list order stable when filtering so keyboard users do not lose their place.
content: English name exactly as in the directory ("Burmese", not "Myanmar language").
Badge words: Read, Listen, Print, App. No other labels.
